$comment: Illustrative FMES-shaped export payload. The real Forest Monitoring and Evaluation System (fmes.rfa.rw) is credential-gated and calculates 24 forestry indicators from field data. This sample mimics a plausible approved-data export so the fmes-adapter script can demonstrate the interoperability seam: FMES-shaped data in, dashboard indicator updates out, with FMES remaining the system of record. The actual export schema is confirmed with RFA during the inception FMES Interoperability Assessment.
spatial_reference: ITRF2005 / TM Rwanda (transformed to WGS84 on ingest)

records.method: Field reporting via FMES mobile application
